documentation: Install certificate.pem, key.pem and chain.pem on the target system and restart the service.
renewalScriptTemplate: # Replace the certificate files on the target system and restart the service.

de.documentation: Installiere certificate.pem, key.pem und chain.pem auf dem Zielsystem und starte den Dienst neu.

documentation: Imports the certificate with its key into the Local Computer store and moves every HTTPS binding whose certificate has the same subject to it. Assign the certificate to a new binding once in IIS Manager; renewals are rebound automatically.

de.documentation: Importiert Zertifikat und Schlüssel in den Speicher Lokaler Computer und stellt alle HTTPS-Bindungen um, deren Zertifikat denselben Antragsteller hat. Weise das Zertifikat einer neuen Bindung einmal im IIS-Manager zu; Erneuerungen werden automatisch umgebunden.

purpose: RDP, WinRM and other Windows services
documentation: Imports the certificate with its key into the Local Computer store (LocalMachine\My). Select the new certificate in the service that uses it, for example the RDP listener or a WinRM HTTPS listener.
renewalScriptTemplate:
#Requires -RunAsAdministrator
# Imports the certificate with its key into LocalMachine\My. Point the service (for example RDP or WinRM over HTTPS) to the new thumbprint once.
$certificate = Import-HomeCACertificate certificate.pfx

de.documentation: Importiert Zertifikat und Schlüssel in den Speicher Lokaler Computer (LocalMachine\My). Wähle das neue Zertifikat im Dienst aus, der es nutzt, etwa im RDP-Listener oder in einem WinRM-HTTPS-Listener.

purpose: RDP connections to Windows servers and PCs
documentation: Imports the certificate with its key into the Local Computer store, lets the Remote Desktop service (NETWORK SERVICE) read the key and points the RDP-Tcp listener to the new thumbprint on every renewal. Open sessions stay connected. Clients must trust the HomeCA root CA and connect with a name or IP address that is in the certificate.

de.documentation: Importiert Zertifikat und Schlüssel in den Speicher Lokaler Computer, gibt dem Remotedesktopdienst (NETWORK SERVICE) Lesezugriff auf den Schlüssel und stellt den Listener RDP-Tcp bei jeder Erneuerung auf den neuen Thumbprint um. Offene Sitzungen bleiben bestehen. Clients müssen der HomeCA-Root-CA vertrauen und sich mit einem Namen oder einer IP-Adresse verbinden, die im Zertifikat steht.

documentation: Copy fullchain.pem to /etc/pve/local/pveproxy-ssl.pem and key.pem to /etc/pve/local/pveproxy-ssl.key, then restart pveproxy.
renewalScriptTemplate:
cp fullchain.pem /etc/pve/local/pveproxy-ssl.pem
cp key.pem /etc/pve/local/pveproxy-ssl.key
systemctl restart pveproxy

de.documentation: Kopiere fullchain.pem nach /etc/pve/local/pveproxy-ssl.pem und key.pem nach /etc/pve/local/pveproxy-ssl.key, dann pveproxy neu starten.

documentation: Import the certificate and key under System > Trust > Certificates and select it for the web GUI.
renewalScriptTemplate:
# Import the certificate in the OPNsense web interface:
# System > Trust > Certificates > Add > Import an existing certificate
# Then select it under System > Settings > Administration > SSL Certificate.

de.documentation: Importiere Zertifikat und Schlüssel über System > Trust > Certificates und wähle es für die Web-GUI.

documentation: Place fullchain.pem and key.pem in the configured SSL directory and set ssl_certificate and ssl_key in configuration.yaml.
renewalScriptTemplate:
cp fullchain.pem /ssl/fullchain.pem
cp key.pem /ssl/privkey.pem
ha core restart

de.documentation: Lege fullchain.pem und key.pem im konfigurierten SSL-Verzeichnis ab und setze ssl_certificate sowie ssl_key in configuration.yaml.

purpose: UniFi Network Controller and UniFi OS Console
documentation: Copy certificate.pem and key.pem to the UniFi appliance. On UniFi OS: Settings > System > Advanced > upload the TLS certificate. For a self-hosted controller: create a PKCS12 keystore and import it into /var/lib/unifi/keystore.
renewalScriptTemplate:
# UniFi OS: upload through the web interface under System > Advanced > Custom Certificate.
# Self-hosted controller:
homeca_backup /var/lib/unifi/keystore
openssl pkcs12 -export -in certificate.pem -inkey key.pem -certfile chain.pem -out unifi.p12 -name unifi -password pass:aircontrolenterprise
keytool -importkeystore -srckeystore unifi.p12 -srcstoretype PKCS12 -srcstorepass aircontrolenterprise -destkeystore /var/lib/unifi/keystore -deststorepass aircontrolenterprise -destkeypass aircontrolenterprise -noprompt
systemctl restart unifi

de.purpose: UniFi Network Controller und UniFi OS Console
de.documentation: Kopiere certificate.pem und key.pem auf die UniFi-Appliance. Bei UniFi OS: Einstellungen > System > Erweitert > TLS-Zertifikat hochladen. Bei selbst gehostetem Controller: Erstelle einen PKCS12-Keystore und importiere ihn in /var/lib/unifi/keystore.

documentation: HAProxy expects a single PEM file containing key, certificate and chain. Use the combined export (bundle.pem) or concatenate the files: cat key.pem certificate.pem chain.pem > /etc/haproxy/certs/service.pem.
renewalScriptTemplate:
cp bundle.pem /etc/haproxy/certs/service.pem
systemctl reload haproxy

de.documentation: HAProxy erwartet eine einzelne PEM-Datei mit Schlüssel, Zertifikat und Chain. Verwende den kombinierten Export (bundle.pem) oder füge die Dateien zusammen: cat key.pem certificate.pem chain.pem > /etc/haproxy/certs/service.pem.

purpose: nginx reverse proxy and web server
documentation: Copy fullchain.pem and key.pem into the nginx SSL directory (for example /etc/nginx/ssl/). In the server block, set ssl_certificate to fullchain.pem and ssl_certificate_key to key.pem, then reload nginx.
renewalScriptTemplate:
cp fullchain.pem /etc/nginx/ssl/fullchain.pem
cp key.pem /etc/nginx/ssl/key.pem
nginx -t && systemctl reload nginx

de.documentation: Kopiere fullchain.pem und key.pem in das nginx-SSL-Verzeichnis (z. B. /etc/nginx/ssl/). Setze im Server-Block ssl_certificate auf fullchain.pem und ssl_certificate_key auf key.pem. Dann nginx neu laden.

purpose: Cisco IOS/IOS-XE web interface and SSH
documentation: Import certificate and key through the Cisco CLI. Create a trustpoint, import the PKCS12 archive with 'crypto pki import <trustpoint> pkcs12' and assign the trustpoint to the HTTPS server.
renewalScriptTemplate:
conf t
no crypto pki certificate chain HOMECA
crypto pki import HOMECA pkcs12 terminal password <pfx-password>
ip http secure-trustpoint HOMECA
end
write memory

de.documentation: Importiere Zertifikat und Schlüssel über die Cisco-CLI. Erstelle einen Trustpoint, importiere das PKCS12-Archiv mit 'crypto pki import <trustpoint> pkcs12' und weise den Trustpoint dem HTTPS-Server zu.

documentation: Upload the PEM certificate and key to the switch via SFTP/SCP and import them into the PKI realm with 'pki import-certificate'. The exact commands vary by VRP version.
renewalScriptTemplate:
system-view
pki realm homeca
 certificate-file import file certificate.pem
 private-key-file import file key.pem
quit
return
save

de.documentation: Lade das PEM-Zertifikat und den Schlüssel per SFTP/SCP auf den Switch und importiere sie über das PKI-Realm mit 'pki import-certificate'. Die genauen Befehle variieren je nach VRP-Version.

documentation: Open DSM > Control Panel > Security > Certificate. Click Add > Import certificate. Upload certificate.pem as the certificate, key.pem as the private key and chain.pem as the intermediate certificate.
renewalScriptTemplate:
# DSM web interface: Control Panel > Security > Certificate.
# Alternatively as root, with CERT_ID set to the directory name below _archive:
CERT_DIR="/usr/syno/etc/certificate/_archive/${CERT_ID:?set CERT_ID to the DSM certificate directory}"
cp certificate.pem "$CERT_DIR/cert.pem"
cp key.pem "$CERT_DIR/privkey.pem"
cp chain.pem "$CERT_DIR/chain.pem"
synosystemctl restart nginx

de.documentation: Öffne DSM > Systemsteuerung > Sicherheit > Zertifikat. Klicke auf Hinzufügen > Zertifikat importieren. Lade certificate.pem als Zertifikat, key.pem als privaten Schlüssel und chain.pem als Zwischenzertifikat hoch.

documentation: TeamCity uses a Java keystore or an upstream reverse proxy. For direct HTTPS: export the PFX from HomeCA as certificate.pfx, import it into a Java keystore and configure the keystore parameters. Behind a reverse proxy: use the proxy's profile.
renewalScriptTemplate:
# Export the PFX from HomeCA as certificate.pfx into this folder first.
homeca_backup /opt/teamcity/conf/keystore.jks
keytool -importkeystore -srckeystore certificate.pfx -srcstoretype PKCS12 -destkeystore /opt/teamcity/conf/keystore.jks -deststoretype JKS -deststorepass changeit -noprompt
systemctl restart teamcity

de.documentation: TeamCity nutzt einen Java-Keystore oder einen vorgeschalteten Reverse Proxy. Bei direktem HTTPS: Exportiere die PFX aus HomeCA als certificate.pfx, importiere sie in einen Java-Keystore und konfiguriere die Keystore-Parameter. Bei Reverse Proxy: Verwende das Profil des Proxys.

documentation: Open Internet > Permit Access > FRITZ!Box Services > Certificate, choose Import certificate and upload bundle.pem (key, certificate and chain in one file) without a password.
renewalScriptTemplate:
# FRITZ!Box web interface:
# Internet > Permit Access > FRITZ!Box Services > Certificate > Import certificate
# File: bundle.pem (private key, certificate and chain), no password

de.documentation: Öffne Internet > Freigaben > FRITZ!Box-Dienste > Zertifikat, wähle Zertifikat importieren und lade bundle.pem (Schlüssel, Zertifikat und Kette in einer Datei) ohne Kennwort hoch.

purpose: TrueNAS SCALE and CORE web interface
documentation: Open Credentials > Certificates > Certificates > Add, select Import Certificate, paste fullchain.pem as certificate and key.pem as private key. Then select it under System > General Settings > GUI > GUI SSL Certificate.
renewalScriptTemplate:
# TrueNAS web interface:
# Credentials > Certificates > Certificates > Add > Type: Import Certificate
#   Certificate: contents of fullchain.pem
#   Private Key: contents of key.pem
# System > General Settings > GUI > GUI SSL Certificate: select the imported certificate

de.purpose: Weboberfläche von TrueNAS SCALE und CORE
de.documentation: Öffne Credentials > Certificates > Certificates > Add, wähle Import Certificate und füge fullchain.pem als Zertifikat und key.pem als privaten Schlüssel ein. Wähle es danach unter System > General Settings > GUI > GUI SSL Certificate aus.

documentation: Import the HomeCA chain under System > Cert. Manager > CAs first. Then add the certificate under System > Cert. Manager > Certificates > Add > Import an existing certificate with certificate.pem and key.pem, and select it under System > Advanced > Admin Access > SSL/TLS Certificate.
renewalScriptTemplate:
# pfSense web interface:
# System > Cert. Manager > Certificates > Add/Sign > Method: Import an existing Certificate
#   Certificate data: contents of certificate.pem
#   Private key data: contents of key.pem
# System > Advanced > Admin Access > SSL/TLS Certificate: select it and save

de.documentation: Importiere zuerst die HomeCA-Kette unter System > Cert. Manager > CAs. Füge danach unter System > Cert. Manager > Certificates > Add > Import an existing certificate das Zertifikat mit certificate.pem und key.pem hinzu und wähle es unter System > Advanced > Admin Access > SSL/TLS Certificate aus.

documentation: Unraid reads a combined PEM from /boot/config/ssl/certs/<server name>_unraid_bundle.pem. Combine certificate, chain and key into that file and reload nginx; set Use SSL/TLS to Yes under Settings > Management Access.
renewalScriptTemplate:
homeca_backup "/boot/config/ssl/certs/$(hostname)_unraid_bundle.pem"
cat certificate.pem chain.pem key.pem > "/boot/config/ssl/certs/$(hostname)_unraid_bundle.pem"
/etc/rc.d/rc.nginx reload

de.documentation: Unraid liest eine kombinierte PEM-Datei aus /boot/config/ssl/certs/<Servername>_unraid_bundle.pem. Füge Zertifikat, Kette und Schlüssel darin zusammen und lade nginx neu; stelle unter Einstellungen > Verwaltungszugriff „SSL/TLS verwenden“ auf Ja.

purpose: Traefik reverse proxy with file provider
documentation: Copy fullchain.pem and key.pem into the certificate directory and list them in the dynamic configuration (tls.certificates with certFile and keyFile). Traefik watches the file provider and picks up replaced files without a restart. For services that support ACME, the HomeCA ACME directory is the simpler choice.
renewalScriptTemplate:
install -d /etc/traefik/certs
cp fullchain.pem /etc/traefik/certs/homeca.crt
cp key.pem /etc/traefik/certs/homeca.key
# Dynamic configuration (once):
# tls:
#   certificates:
#     - certFile: /etc/traefik/certs/homeca.crt
#       keyFile: /etc/traefik/certs/homeca.key

de.documentation: Kopiere fullchain.pem und key.pem in das Zertifikatsverzeichnis und trage sie in der dynamischen Konfiguration ein (tls.certificates mit certFile und keyFile). Traefik überwacht den File-Provider und übernimmt ersetzte Dateien ohne Neustart. Für ACME-fähige Dienste ist das HomeCA-ACME-Verzeichnis der einfachere Weg.

purpose: Caddy web server and reverse proxy
documentation: Copy fullchain.pem and key.pem to /etc/caddy/certs and reference them in the site block with 'tls /etc/caddy/certs/fullchain.pem /etc/caddy/certs/key.pem', then reload Caddy. Caddy can also obtain certificates itself from the HomeCA ACME directory.
renewalScriptTemplate:
install -d -o caddy -g caddy /etc/caddy/certs
install -o caddy -g caddy -m 600 fullchain.pem key.pem /etc/caddy/certs/
systemctl reload caddy

de.documentation: Kopiere fullchain.pem und key.pem nach /etc/caddy/certs, trage sie im Site-Block mit 'tls /etc/caddy/certs/fullchain.pem /etc/caddy/certs/key.pem' ein und lade Caddy neu. Caddy kann Zertifikate auch selbst über das HomeCA-ACME-Verzeichnis beziehen.

documentation: Open SSL Certificates > Add SSL Certificate > Custom. Upload key.pem as Certificate Key, certificate.pem as Certificate and chain.pem as Intermediate Certificate, then select the certificate in the proxy host's SSL tab.
renewalScriptTemplate:
# Nginx Proxy Manager web interface:
# SSL Certificates > Add SSL Certificate > Custom
#   Certificate Key: key.pem
#   Certificate: certificate.pem
#   Intermediate Certificate: chain.pem
# Proxy Hosts > Edit > SSL: select the certificate

de.purpose: Eigenes Zertifikat im Nginx Proxy Manager
de.documentation: Öffne SSL Certificates > Add SSL Certificate > Custom. Lade key.pem als Certificate Key, certificate.pem als Certificate und chain.pem als Intermediate Certificate hoch und wähle das Zertifikat im SSL-Reiter des Proxy-Hosts aus.

documentation: Either upload fullchain.pem and key.pem under Settings > SSL certificate, or mount them into the container and start Portainer with --sslcert /certs/fullchain.pem --sslkey /certs/key.pem. The script assumes the mounted directory /opt/portainer/certs and a container named portainer.
renewalScriptTemplate:
install -d /opt/portainer/certs
cp fullchain.pem key.pem /opt/portainer/certs/
docker restart portainer

de.documentation: Lade fullchain.pem und key.pem unter Settings > SSL certificate hoch oder binde sie in den Container ein und starte Portainer mit --sslcert /certs/fullchain.pem --sslkey /certs/key.pem. Das Skript geht vom eingebundenen Verzeichnis /opt/portainer/certs und einem Container namens portainer aus.

documentation: Enable SSH on the host, copy fullchain.pem and key.pem to the host and replace /etc/vmware/ssl/rui.crt and rui.key, then restart hostd and vpxa. Hosts managed by vCenter should get their certificate through vCenter instead.
renewalScriptTemplate:
cp fullchain.pem /etc/vmware/ssl/rui.crt
cp key.pem /etc/vmware/ssl/rui.key
/etc/init.d/hostd restart
/etc/init.d/vpxa restart

de.documentation: Aktiviere SSH auf dem Host, kopiere fullchain.pem und key.pem auf den Host und ersetze /etc/vmware/ssl/rui.crt und rui.key, danach hostd und vpxa neu starten. Von vCenter verwaltete Hosts sollten ihr Zertifikat stattdessen über vCenter erhalten.

documentation: Upload key and certificate with racadm and reset the iDRAC. Alternatively, generate a CSR in the iDRAC (iDRAC Settings > Services > SSL) and sign it in HomeCA under Sign CSR; then only the certificate has to be uploaded.
renewalScriptTemplate:
racadm -r <idrac-host> -u <user> -p <password> sslkeyupload -t 1 -f key.pem
racadm -r <idrac-host> -u <user> -p <password> sslcertupload -t 1 -f certificate.pem
racadm -r <idrac-host> -u <user> -p <password> racreset soft

de.documentation: Lade Schlüssel und Zertifikat mit racadm hoch und starte den iDRAC neu. Alternativ erzeugst du im iDRAC einen CSR (iDRAC Settings > Services > SSL) und signierst ihn in HomeCA unter „CSR signieren“; dann muss nur das Zertifikat hochgeladen werden.

purpose: Nextcloud or other sites served by Apache
documentation: Copy fullchain.pem and key.pem to /etc/ssl/homeca, set SSLCertificateFile to fullchain.pem and SSLCertificateKeyFile to key.pem in the virtual host and reload Apache. Add the host name to trusted_domains in Nextcloud's config.php.
renewalScriptTemplate:
install -d -m 750 /etc/ssl/homeca
install -m 644 fullchain.pem /etc/ssl/homeca/fullchain.pem
install -m 600 key.pem /etc/ssl/homeca/key.pem
apachectl configtest && systemctl reload apache2

de.purpose: Nextcloud oder andere Seiten unter Apache
de.documentation: Kopiere fullchain.pem und key.pem nach /etc/ssl/homeca, setze im VirtualHost SSLCertificateFile auf fullchain.pem und SSLCertificateKeyFile auf key.pem und lade Apache neu. Trage den Hostnamen in Nextclouds config.php unter trusted_domains ein.

documentation: Jellyfin expects a PKCS#12 file. The script builds /etc/jellyfin/jellyfin.pfx without a password; set it under Dashboard > Networking > Custom SSL certificate path and enable HTTPS.
renewalScriptTemplate:
homeca_backup /etc/jellyfin/jellyfin.pfx
openssl pkcs12 -export -in certificate.pem -inkey key.pem -certfile chain.pem -out /etc/jellyfin/jellyfin.pfx -passout pass:
chown jellyfin:jellyfin /etc/jellyfin/jellyfin.pfx
chmod 600 /etc/jellyfin/jellyfin.pfx
systemctl restart jellyfin

de.documentation: Jellyfin erwartet eine PKCS#12-Datei. Das Skript erzeugt /etc/jellyfin/jellyfin.pfx ohne Kennwort; trage sie unter Dashboard > Netzwerk > Pfad zum benutzerdefinierten SSL-Zertifikat ein und aktiviere HTTPS.
